about.title: About Me
about.name: Nattakit Kerdtalay (Max)
about.bio:
I have a deep passion for computer technology and a strong commitment to continuously developing new skills. Although my academic background is in Industrial Engineering, I made a deliberate and determined decision to transition into the field of software development.

This transition was driven not by circumstance, but by a genuine passion for technology and the endless possibilities it creates. I found myself always curious about how software thinks, how AI learns, how systems come alive — became a passion that desire to build them with my own hands. 

So I committed myself to learning seriously — from the fundamentals to increasingly complex concepts. And even now, fully into this field, I never stop exploring new things and sharpening my skills. Because for me, there is always more to learn — and that's exactly what keeps me moving forward.

zentrix.title: Zentrix.ai
zentrix.description: Zentrix.ai is an intelligent Agentic Chat Interface designed to bridge the gap between complex databases and business insights. By leveraging an AI Agent architecture, the platform enables users to query connected databases using natural language. Zentrix.ai doesn't just 'talk—it' but 'acts' by autonomously selecting and executing the right tools to perform data analysis tasks, summarize data insights, and track everything within the chat.
responsibilities: Developed AI agent and tools services using LangChain with Gemini.
Tracked AI evaluation and behavior monitoring using LangSmith.
Developed responsive user interface using React.js web application.
Implemented AI session and conversational memory persistence in MongoDB database.

delph.title: Delph.ai
delph.description: Delph.ai is an advanced AI-driven chat interface designed to transform how users interact with complex documents. Built on a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, the application allows users to upload PDF files and engage in a dynamic conversation with the content. Delph.ai leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to parse dense information, providing instant, contextually accurate answers while grounding its responses directly in the uploaded source material.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for accurate data extraction.
Processed, embedded, and stored high-volume datasets using vector databases (FAISS DB).
Built seamless chat interface frontend interacting with LangChain backend.

sumi.title: Sumi.ai
sumi.description: Sumi.ai is an intelligent AI Recruitment & Candidate Prescreening Platform designed to revolutionize the hiring process. By integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, the system automates the tedious task of manual resume screening. Sumi.ai allows HR professionals to define specific job requirements and leverages AI to critically analyze, score, and rank candidates based on their experience, skills, and qualifications, significantly reducing time-to-hire while improving placement quality.
responsibilities: Fine-tuned LLMs for structured data extraction and formatting from complex PDF resumes.
Implemented ranking algorithms to match candidates against dynamic job descriptions.
Engineered prompt templates and system agents to provide intelligent candidate summaries and interactions.
